title: •Malakili
caption: •Malakili (V)
game_text: Deploys -4 on Tatooine. Rancors may deploy here (even if Malakili is not the only character, habitat permitting), are defense value +4 here, and may not attack Malakili. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Rancor here.
lore: Corellian. Worked for Circus Horrificus. Disapproves of Jabba’s treatment of the rancor. Plotting with Lady Valarian to steal the immense beast away from Jabba’s palace.
copyright: TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 1, third box blank; deploy 6 / forfeit 3 (printed 3 / 2). Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Alien (Jabba's Palace grey alien frame). Slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; otherwise matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophes in Jabba’s (×2) (wiki straight); no bold characteristic words (Corellian is a species). Base scan only at 350 px (JP-D-malakili.gif); copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace) not legible at 350 px — Hoth-style line per the brief. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3-D-malakili-pre.gif, 350 px); non-pre VB3 also exists, not downloaded.
